info.title: We Work Remotely Jobs API: Remote Listings by Keyword
info.description:
Remote job listings from We Work Remotely as JSON: title, company, category, region, posting date and full description, filtered by keyword or category.

Sold on API.market: https://api.market/store/benthepythondev/weworkremotely-jobs (plans, free trial and API key). Call it through the API.market gateway with your API.market key in the x-api-market-key header.

post.description: Scrape We Work Remotely jobs by keyword across every category: title, company, region, job type, salary, apply-before date, allowed countries, skills, description and URL. Up to 20 results per request, as JSON.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keep only jobs whose title, company or description contains at least one of these words (case-insensitive), e.g. python, react, account executive. Empty keeps every job.

categoryUrls.title: Category URLs
categoryUrls.description: We Work Remotely category feed URLs to scrape exactly.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Category shortcuts. `all` reads every WWR category (about 500 jobs, duplicates removed). Others: programming, back-end, front-end, full-stack, devops, design, customer-support, sales, marketing (same feed as sales), management-and-finance, product, all-other.

maxResults.title: Max results per category
maxResults.description: Maximum jobs to return per category feed (after the keyword filter). A request returns 20 rows at most.

includeDetails.title: Include job details
includeDetails.description: Read each job's page for job type, salary (when the employer shows it), apply-before date, allowed countries for geo-locked jobs and skills.

includeCompany.title: Include company profile
includeCompany.description: Also read the hiring company's WWR profile once per company: logo, website, location and About text.

201.description: The results, one object per row.
